objective: Ensure access to financial services including savings, credit, insurance, and pension for excluded sections.
description: Launched 28.8.2014. Provides Basic Savings Bank Deposit (BSBD) account with no minimum balance. Free RuPay debit card with accident insurance Rs 2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for pre-28.8.2018 accounts). Overdraft up to Rs 10,000. Financial literacy programs. As of 28.02.2025: 54.97 crore accounts; Rs 2,52,750 crore deposits; 30.60 crore women accounts (55.7%); 36.59 crore rural/semi-urban (66.6%); 37.60 crore RuPay cards. Extended beyond 14.8.2018 with focus shifting to every unbanked adult.
